verdict.rationale: Helicone instruments apps through its proxy/AI Gateway. You use the existing OpenAI SDK with a one- or two-line change, and the docs list one-line integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini and the Vercel AI SDK. That implies JS/TS (Vercel AI SDK) and likely Python usage, but through third-party SDKs rather than Helicone-owned ones. Missing for 10: any evidence of official first-party Helicone SDKs, explicit Python and JS/TS language support documentation, and independent corroboration of SDK-based instrumentation in both languages.
